title: Fall Shred Day - Bluffton
summary: You're Invited to Our Complimentary Shred Day Event at Our Bluffton Branch
body_markdown:
You're invited to our complimentary Shred Day event at our Bluffton branch. Safely dispose of sensitive documents to protect yourself and/or your business from fraud.


**Date:** Saturday, October 3, 2026


**Time:** 10:00 pm to 12:00 pm


**Location:** Bluffton Branch, 7 Thurmond Way Bluffton, SC 29910


**Limit of 5 boxes per person**


**Accepted items** : Paper (any color), Staples, Post-Its, Junk Mail, Check Registers, Newspapers, Magazines, Paper Clips


**Not accepted:** Big Binder Clips, Notebooks, Batteries, Electronics, Glass, Metal, Liquids, Hazardous Materials, Plastic, Cardboard, CD’s, Fabric, Wood, Candy Wrappers, Guns/Ammo
